name: Rafael Reyes — daughter Rita (b./d. 1913)
researcher_question: Did Rafael Reyes and his wife Serapia Benavides Cueva of Usulután, El Salvador have a daughter named Rita, born and died in 1913?
notes: Record-hint fixture (filtered-list-samples.csv row 16, flag adds_daughter, confidence 3). First resolved 2026-07-31 as a false match, based on the FamilySearch derivative index alone: an extra given name ('Manuel') on the father, a different specific town, a 53-year gap since the tree couple's only recorded marriage, and no birth record for Rita. Reopened 2026-08-04 after a scored run examined the original register image (not just the index) and found it states directly that Rita — an adult woman who died in childbirth in January 1913 — was 'hija legítima de Manuel Rafael Reyes y Serapia Benavides.' Resolved as a probable true match on the strength of that direct filiation statement; the locality and 53-year-gap objections from the first pass were not independently re-examined this round. See README 'Notes for reviewers'.
